title: R&SVP – Hio Ridge | Barn wedding venue, Bridgton, Maine
description: A barn raised in 1820 on a family farm in Bridgton, Maine. Sunday weddings for up to 135, the ceremony facing Pleasant Mountain. Alcohol-free. Now booking 2027.

hero.alt: Inside the barn at Hio Ridge in the evening: the timber frame, chandeliers, and the loft rail
hero.headline: Vows in front of the mountain. *Dinner under the beams.*
hero.line: A Sunday wedding on a family farm in Bridgton, Maine

statement.quote: Hang your dress on the hook. The rest of the day is ours to worry about.
statement.who: Susan, who gives every tour herself

intro.heading: Four generations have kept this farm. *For one Sunday, it keeps you.*
body: Susan's great-grandparents bought the land in 1941. In 2020 she and Richard took the 1820 barn down to its frame and rebuilt it from its own boards, with the windows from the house.
It seats 135 under the beams. The ell beside it has a room for the bride and a room for the groom. The field in front faces Pleasant Mountain.
intro.alt: The head table set at the open French doors, the field beyond

paths.title: The field
paths.body: Vows facing Pleasant Mountain, on benches cut from the barn's old floorboards.
paths.alt: Benches in the field and the farmhouse in evening light

paths.title: The barn
paths.body: Dinner and dancing for 135 under beams raised in 1820, the French doors open to the patio.
paths.alt: Inside the barn in the evening, chandeliers and the loft rail

paths.title: The ell
paths.body: A room for the bride and a room for the groom, with a hook made for the dress.
paths.alt: A wedding dress on the hook in the bridal room

setting.heading: Come in October, *when the color comes down to the barn door*
setting.body: The field looks straight at Pleasant Mountain. Susan gives tours every day of the month, and the late light is the best argument we have.
setting.alt: The barn across the lawn in early October, trees turning along the tree line

evening.heading: Evenings on the ridge
evening.body: String lights on the patio, the stone circle in the field, and the sun going down behind the barn.
evening.alt: The barn at night, windows lit, French doors open onto the patio

proof.title: Open house
proof.body: Tours of the barn and the ell, with the High Street Jazz Band playing inside.

proof.title: Ribbon cutting
proof.body: The Maine Lakes Chamber of Commerce, filmed by Lakes Region TV.

proof.title: Occupancy approved
proof.body: Town of Bridgton. 135 guests, May through October.

story_teaser.heading: Susan and Richard
story_teaser.body: They spend the season here and the winter in California. They give every tour themselves, and they are at every event.
story_teaser.alt: Susan and Richard Voth at the barn door

closing.heading: Stand in the field. *Then decide.*
closing.body: A tour takes an hour with the people who own the farm. You will see the barn, the ell and the field, and leave with the pricing brochure and the open Sundays.

included_heading: One couple. One Sunday. The whole farm.
